Chiptune USB/CV v0.10.0-alpha — dedicated RP2040/SAA1099/SN76489AN board

Use chiptune-v0.10.0-alpha.uf2.
Settings version 10 / SysEx protocol 2 / schema 10. Old settings, USER sounds,
calibration and brightness are ignored, not migrated. Boot never erases/writes
settings. Explicit save may overwrite an old bank: back up old data first.

See the source repository firmware/README.md for operation and build commands,
firmware/BOOT_RECOVERY.md for recovery, firmware/BRINGUP.md for the unverified
hardware checklist, and firmware/ARCHITECTURE.md for performance limitations.
Included Verification/Boot/Runtime/PIO/Test/Performance reports describe software
checks only. Hardware sound, physical bus timing, power-cut retention and the
1 ms device WCET are NOT verified. Development USB VID/PID is not an assigned
production identity. LICENSES and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES cover bundled runtimes.
